source.section: Military Retirement Income Exemption Worksheet questions 1-3 and Lines 4-10 (booklet PDF p.17; IN-112 Instructions PDF pp.3-4 Line 13); Schedule IN-112 Part I Line 13 (booklet PDF p.23); Form IN-111 Lines 1-8 and 14 (booklet PDF pp.10-11), standard deduction chart and Lines 4-5e (PDF p.11), rate schedules (PDF p.46)

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (person 0) 50,010.00 + military retirement pay (DFAS 1099-R) (person 0) 40,000.00 = 90,010.00. Federal taxable income = 90,010.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction = 74,260.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form IN-111, Single: Line 1 federal AGI 90,010.00. Schedule IN-112 Part I: Line 1 all state and local obligation interest 0.00; Line 2 Vermont obligations 0.00; Line 3 = 0.00; Line 4 0.00; Line 6 total additions 0.00. Military Retirement Income Exemption Worksheet: question 2, AGI 90,010.00 is less than 175,000.00; question 3, not over 125,000.00: full exemption of the military retirement pay 40,000.00. Line 13 40,000.00. Subtractions: Line 13 military retirement 40,000.00; Line 18 total subtractions 40,000.00. Line 19 net modifications = 0.00 - 40,000.00 = -40,000.00. Form IN-111 Line 2 -40,000.00; Line 3 = 90,010.00 + (-40,000.00) = 50,010.00. Line 4 standard deduction 7,650.00 (no age box) [person 0 born 1965-03-01 (not born before Jan. 2, 1961: no box)]. Line 5a-5d personal exemptions 1; Line 5e 1 x 5,300.00 = 5,300.00. Line 6 = 7,650.00 + 5,300.00 = 12,950.00. Line 7 Vermont taxable income = 50,010.00 - 12,950.00 = 37,060.00. Line 8: schedule tax on 37,060.00 (Schedule X, booklet p.46, merged continuous schedule): 3.35% x (37,060.00 - 0.00) = 1,241.51; the tax table (pp.47-51) gives 1241. Federal AGI 90,010.00 is not greater than 150,000.00, so no minimum tax: Line 8 1,241.51. Line 9 0.00 (no Schedule IN-119 items; Credit for the Elderly or the Disabled not modelled); Line 10 1,241.51; Lines 11-13 0.00; Line 14 Vermont income tax 1,241.51.
accepted_approximations: The rate schedule is one continuous schedule: the printed rows that restart at 75,000 are merged and printed base taxes, rounded to the dollar, are not used. Below 75,000 the booklet uses tax tables in 100 dollar rows.
